inspection_scope: Complete supplied script, rhetorical chapters, eight setups, twelve beat contracts, assets, transitions, continuity-token lifecycles and limitations. Data-only assessment of planned structure before animation.

checks.evidence: Distinct worlds handle introduction, connection, ordered processing, classification, permission, commercial access and relationship transformation. Within s02, the cloud shelf serves the existing app network; within s04, successive folio layers develop classification and availability rather than adding unrelated machinery.

s03 compresses processed assignment folds as evidence of completed steps. s04 folds present-use leaves away before future layers become focal. s07 retains the folded answer pedestal as a subordinate component of the broader working relationship. Other mechanisms leave at setup boundaries.

The app sockets in s02 form one connected network; the ordered stops in s03 form one assignment; paired leaves and entrances in s04 and s06 support classification and comparison. Human key, shutter and pending slip in s05 belong to one permission relationship.

Contracts progress through separate computing stations, a diagonal socket network, a depth-oriented accordion, an opening folio, a close permission boundary, unequal paired entrances and a vertical-to-horizontal work-surface transformation. Repeated permission staging in s08 has an explicit callback purpose and a new human-led action.

The Dot has an ordered lifecycle across all setups, changing position and relationship while previous sets disappear. The human key appears in s05 and returns in s08 to connect withheld approval with the unresolved final choice; it remains human-held.

Planned geometry supplies computing separation, connection contacts, processing states, availability restrictions, access conditions or human control. Opening desk and cable crops locate the user computer; folio edges expose upcoming layers; uneven folds and stacks distinguish meaningful states.

Semantic shifts from connection to processing, processing to pitch classification, classification to permission, permission to commercial access and access to implication receive distinct sets. Naming, network expansion, folio replacement and relationship transformation persist while their existing rule develops. Chapters and setups cover the narration in order, assigning every beat once.

Contracts sequence connection before cloud seating, present uses before future layers, specialist before team emphasis and access conditions before comparison completion. s03 places the processing action within a foreground-page aperture. In s05, the static human-held key supports the slip's stop rather than introducing a separate action; s08 makes the key approach primary.

Central before/after states communicate separation, persistence, connection, ordered progress, restricted availability, interrupted execution, unequal access conditions and an unresolved key transfer. Necessary local names and status labels accompany physical evidence: veiling, unopened folds, ticket restriction and open entrance. Narration captions are not the sole source of these central relationships.

setup_assessments.evidence: b01 establishes a separate computing station and continuing assignment; b02 changes to a token detail within that station. Naming develops the introduced identity, and the station and Bot leave before the next world.

b03 replaces containment with seated app connections; b04 adds the computing seat serving that network and shifts emphasis upward. Retained connections explain the current arrangement rather than becoming obsolete machinery.

Ordered stops, compressed completed folds and the emerging draft develop one assignment. The separate foreground page establishes background work, while its aperture preserves the processing action as the planned center.

b06 opens two proposed-use leaves; b07 folds them away and sequentially emphasizes a veiled specialist layer and unopened team fold. The folio provides one classification rule with meaningful replacement and physical status restrictions.

The pending slip approaches and stops at one human-controlled boundary. The withheld key explains control of that stop; no approval or execution follows. The commercial-access comparison receives a separate set.
Sequentially revealed ticket-dependent and open entrances constitute one access comparison. The extras tab remains subordinate and separate; no passage, performance ranking or winner is asserted.

b10 visibly folds a narrow answer pedestal into a broader surface; b11 occupies the new coworker position and sustains assigned work. The retained answer component supports the broadened relationship, and the work surface leaves before the final callback.

The returning permission boundary and human key have a justified callback lifecycle. The human-led approach stops before insertion, leaving a changed but unresolved state and preserving the viewer's decision.

limits: Data-only review cannot establish rendered/mobile performance, actual visibility, motion hierarchy, contact execution, caption timing or listening quality. These PASS decisions concern the supplied structural contracts and do not approve final artwork, implementation or factual claims.
